capabilities: Publish or update the current note as a Pika post via the Micropub API
Upload local images to Pika and replace references with hosted URLs
Use title and tags from note properties, with filename and defaults as fallbacks
Save the published post URL in note properties for later updates
Set default tags and visibility (Draft/Public) for new posts
extras: Community-maintained and not affiliated with Pika or Obsidian; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes build-from-source instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Pika blog, including uploading local images and updating existing posts.

relations.evidence: lets you publish notes to your Pika blog — right from your vault

summary: Publishing plugin that sends notes from a vault to a Pika blog via the Micropub API, with image upload and post updating.
